scopeReview: CED LIM-5.B.1–2 and LIM-5.C.1–2: finite and limiting Riemann sums, summation indices, widths and sample points, mesh-to-zero convergence for continuous functions, translating to/from definite integrals. Unicode Σ is accompanied by explicit index ranges; integrals use readable “from … to …” bounds in the existing renderer. No unavailable TeX renderer or later integration method is required.
varietyReview: Right-endpoint symbolic construction, arithmetic finite sum, shifted radical-limit translation, specifically midpoint sampling versus other valid sequences, nonuniform general formula, mesh condition and a fixed-wide-interval counterexample, signed integral interpretation, grouped polynomial integrand, midpoint finite expansion, dummy integration variable and indexed unequal reciprocal widths. Three original-function recomputations supplement exact independent notation and hypothesis reviews.
repetitionReview: Each prompt and all four options were read separately; distinct tasks/contexts within this set. Cross-topic exact duplicates checked by validator. Semantic similarity and AP difficulty remain judgment calls, not proven by an automated score.
